Game Overview

In Flappy Orange, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the depths with Flappy Orange, guiding a cute fish through a treacherous underwater world. Master simple, yet challenging controls, balance your rhythm to avoid obstacles, and collect treasures for bonus points. Compete for high scores and enjoy a vibrant oceanic adventure!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Flappy Orange is easy to pick up. Dive into the depths with Flappy Orange, guiding a cute fish through a treacherous underwater world. Master simple, yet challenging controls, balance your rhythm to avoid obstacles, and collect treasures for bonus points. Compete for high scores and enjoy a vibrant oceanic adventure!
